name: Unidentified KX-series security droid (Niamos)
description: A KX-series security droid model supplemented an Imperial shoretrooper garrison on the planet Niamos. After interacting with two individuals moments prior, it was summoned for assistance by a nearby trooper for the interrogation of Cassian Jeron Andor. The droid was then tasked to "hang onto" Andor until the trooper returned from inspecting a local shelter. Interpreting the Imperial's verbal command literally, it proceeded to pin Andor against the wall, hanging him above the ground in a choke hold.
